params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date for the report. Defaults to seven days ago.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date for the report. Defaults to today.

params.name: currency
params.description: ISO 4217 currency code. All ISO 4217 currencies are supported.

params.name: time_zone
params.description: Rails TimeZone constant. Any timezone with a whole-hour offset to UTC is accepted; 30-minute offsets are not supported. Defaults to the user's default in the LiquidM platform.

params.name: dimensions
params.description: Comma-separated dimensions to split the result by.

params.name: filters
params.description: Comma-separated filters in <dimension>-<value> form. Every dimension is also available as a filter.

items.docs: Return reporting data aggregated by the requested granularity, split by the requested dimensions, narrowed by the requested filters, and containing the requested metrics.
